editionLabel: English Ludonova rules, publisher file Rules_Ceylon_2.0_low.pdf
location: Setup step I; Playing; Game variant
firstPlayerRule: In standard play, whoever drank tea most recently starts, or choose randomly. In the optional experienced-player variant, the lowest-numbered starting tile determines who starts.
officialTieBreak: Random selection is an official alternative to the tea criterion, not a stated tie-break sequence.
clarifications: The selected starter receives the teapot and chooses an initial map position first. During play, turns proceed clockwise.

firstPlayerRule: The shortest player starts, or choose the starter randomly.
officialTieBreak: The rulebook permits random selection as an alternative; it does not require a height tie first.

editionLabel: English publisher-hosted US rulebook, nine PDF spreads
location: Setup and Visiting Phase on printed page 9; Start Player Token on page 8
firstPlayerRule: The player with the best acting and reading voice reads the case introduction and takes the start-player token. If the group uses the recorded introduction instead, choose the starter randomly.
officialTieBreak: Random selection is explicitly required when using the recorded introduction; the manual does not give a separate tie-break for the voice criterion.
clarifications: The token holder chooses a location first in the Visiting Phase, followed clockwise by the others. This initial choice differs from later rounds, when the last player to obtain a location takes the token.
